title: DeFi Simplified
description:
There are ~2000 DeFi protocols

But how to find good ones?
There doesn't exist a comprehensive DeFi investment evaluation framework

We have built an extensive "DeFi Investment Evaluation Framework"

Anyone can use this framework to 'easily' assess the risk of their investment, which basically comes from exposure to: 
(1) Asset
(2) Protocol 
(3) Chain
how_its_made:
Fetching metrics to rate assets, protocols and chains could not be done using API
So we pulled the data by creating scripts and manual scraping.
